I just discovered this game randomly, and I'm SO GLAD I BOUGHT IT.
Easily one of the most high-octane Rogue-lite FPS games to date, and only a third of the content is apparently out (according to the devs, at the time of writing this review).

The gameplay is basically if Doom and Borderlands had a baby, with a decent amount of variety for guns, artifacts (permanent upgrades you find in your run via blueprints), cores (stat buffs, of which you can hold up to three per run), a level-up system (as you play, you will get to choose a new passive each time you level up that can give you a variety of unique buffs that only last in your current run), and a camp / home base (which you can also upgrade to give you more guns to pick at the start of each run, and some other things I don't want to spoil :) ).

I cannot wait to see what gets added in next.
I pirated this game but I couldn't live with myself if i didnt support the devs so i brought it honestly It feels a really refined Gunfire reborn
Like a love letter to Salvador. Written by Claptrap.

Will be a lot better with a few updates, personally I'd like to see first an increase in chapters, as theres only two as of right now, both ending with bosses. I find right when i kill that second boss is mostly when i am feeling a build the most, only to go back to the camp. This is okay though, as again the game hasnt even been out a month, and its an incredulous amount of fun. Would 100 percent recommend.

This is how Early Access is done! 

Feature wise it's smoother than most AAA release titles, the soundtrack is just out of this world & the gunplay.. It's just a Jazzy, Dubsteppy DOOM!
